_note: v2.8 plan 46 (no-model lane): an authored recap line lands on the player Overview (section 'What changed' / 'Because of you') once its visible transition fires, and the chapter two title card carries the chapter one recap. The chapter seal summary is a debug response (plumbing only; the recap itself calls no model). assert-player-clean in player mode. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-46-recap.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const NL = String.fromCharCode(10); globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugSceneSummaryResponse = 'The party walked the road and passed the gatehouse.'; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugChapterSealResponse = ['SUMMARY:', 'The party walked the road to the gate and the garrison let them through.', 'SHORT:', 'The party passed the gate.'].join(NL); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); return { cleared: ctx.chat.length === 0 };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(200); } }; const LINE = 'The garrison opened its gates for the party.'; globalThis.__r46 = { pause, until, LINE }; return { at: rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" The road climbs toward a grey gatehouse.

steps.eval: const r = globalThis.__r46; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await r.until(() => rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId === 'gatehouse', 10000, 'the gatehouse transition'); rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await r.pause(800); return { at: 'gatehouse' };

const r = globalThis.__r46; const text = await r.until(() => { const root = document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal'); const t = root?.textContent ?? ''; return t.includes(r.LINE) ? t : null; }, 10000, 'the authored recap line on the Overview'); const label = ['Because of you', 'What changed'].find((l) => text.includes(l)); if (!label) throw new Error('the Overview shows the line without a recap heading'); const section = (globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().narrative?.sections ?? []).find((s) => s.id === 'consequences'); if (!section || !section.lines.includes(r.LINE)) throw new Error('the narrative has no consequences section with the line: ' + JSON.stringify(section)); if (/so-v28|gatehouse\b|road\b|step\s*[:=]/.test(text)) throw new Error('an id or quality key reached the Overview'); return { label, line: r.LINE };
document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal')?.close(); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await globalThis.__r46.pause(500); return true;

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" Past the gate, the party makes camp under the walls.

steps.eval: const r = globalThis.__r46; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await r.until(() => rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId === 'fire', 10000, 'the chapter crossing'); rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await r.pause(1500); const found = await r.until(() => { const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-so="chapter-card"]')]; const card = cards.find((c) => (c.querySelector('[data-so="chapter-card-recap"]')?.textContent ?? '').includes(r.LINE)); return card ? { title: card.querySelector('.so-chapter-card-title')?.textContent ?? null, recap: card.querySelector('[data-so="chapter-card-recap"]').textContent } : null; }, 15000, 'the chapter two title card with the chapter one recap'); if (!/Because of you|What changed/.test(found.recap)) throw new Error('the card recap has no heading: ' + found.recap); return found;
